scope: Independent local metadata audit of S5 train export capture, frozen acceptance, and separate exact-stop receipt. No SSH, prediction payload reads/hashes, tests, replay, or model work.

checks.name: capture and source identity
checks.basis: The capture transport is returncode 0 and hash/length match the durable raw JSON and acceptance. All six base64-decoded metadata/log receipts match the separately saved files byte-for-byte. Acceptance binds source commit 88becca892b3d6b97022cf06076c84a7ab165974, 167 files, manifest SHA-256 f214d944694737a3925acc1d703c18e4ee06839a7e598d0955f472abff661f97, and 18 runtime semantic pins. Raw source-file map equals the admission map (167/167); all 18 sidecar semantic pins are present in that map.

checks.name: ordered fit membership and export scope
checks.basis: Captured fit train membership and sidecar row_groups are exactly equal and ordered, with 10,535 unique IDs; their little-endian int64 membership hash equals acceptance SHA-256 8ebb217415c8cdc8c468bb081a7fa815e90b661fd1714f6d05da434a2fa3bbda. Split SHA-256 is c09f7240396a33ca82977115af8d6067e571c0ec25c58a3c99b438ca2d2294b7; sidecar declares campaign export scope fit and feature_only true. The export contains no evaluation rows.

checks.name: producer output and scientific scope
checks.basis: Acceptance records 659 progress records for 10,535 completed train sequences, source-shaped prediction [10535,20000,2], 1,685,600,128 bytes, and producer whole-file SHA-256 d6e1f58743725c15d609db9d7e13aa897100d363d9225d85ecc96fb8bd48115b. The SHA authority is the producer/sidecar; no independent NPY payload hash, header read, or finite scan was done. FP32 dtype is source-construction/sidecar authority; streamed CPU validation is still required. This export adds zero scientific fits and is not a quality grade.

checks.name: separate exact-stop receipt
checks.basis: The exact-stop raw response is 1,086 bytes with SHA-256 81964bf8e0022797d4d646f18e78cdea2b1e4702cad2f09e7397e5b52827eec8; transport length/hash match and returncode is 0. Its acceptance_before_stop_sha256 equals the frozen acceptance SHA above. It records stop returncode 0 for the exact S5 train unit, then unit not-found/inactive/dead with empty populated descendants. The acceptance remains immutable with its pre-stop PENDING status; the later stop is separate evidence.

limitations: This audit does not independently validate prediction array bytes, NPY header, finiteness, or model quality.
The exact-stop parent memory sample is historical to that stop capture and is not a current parent-headroom assertion.
